props.name: rendererOptions
props.description: Grid-wide scroll presentation policy — live-mode budgets, html-snapshot cache limits, text-impostor defaults. Initial-only.

props.name: dataIntegrity
props.description: Unified Data Integrity pipeline — validation, quality, diff, live stream, conflict resolution.

props.name: capabilities
props.description: Grid-level capability rules. Control which actions are allowed per cell, column, or row.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Enable the core pagination bar (and, in client mode, page-window row slicing).

props.name: showStatusBar
props.description: Show the core status bar (row + selection counts).

props.name: showFilterChipBar
props.description: Show the filter chip bar above the header when filters are active.

props.name: showFloatingFilters
props.description: Show the floating filter row — always-visible inline filter inputs below column headers.

props.name: rowDragMode
props.description: Row drag mode: 'managed' (grid auto-reorders) or 'unmanaged' (host applies order).

props.name: getRowHeight
props.description: Per-row height callback. Return a pixel height for each row, or `undefined` to use `defaultRowHeight`. Overridden by `api.setRowHeight()`. Initial-only.
